name: kompare
description: Package holidays and niche trips from Danish travel agencies: live prices in DKK and booking links.

interface.longDescription:
Kompare compares package holidays and niche trips sold by Danish travel agencies, for the Danish market, with prices in Danish kroner (DKK): ski, golf, sun and beach charter, cruises, city breaks, hiking, cycling, football and Formula 1 trips, holiday homes and more. Other countries are not covered yet.

Ask in plain words, in English or Danish, for a kind of trip, places, dates, your party and a budget. Kompare answers with live prices for exactly the party you asked about, and a link to book each trip on the travel agency's own website.

Tools:
- find_trips: describe the trip in plain words ("ski in Ischgl in February for two adults") and get bookable trips back in one call.
- search_listings: every filter, such as meal plan, hotel stars, transport, lift pass included or distance to the lift.
- search_init and get_facets: what is available for a kind of trip, which destinations have the most trips and which months are cheapest.

Unless asked for the cheapest or the soonest, trips come in Kompare's own order, which weighs price, quality and the commission the travel agency pays Kompare. No account or sign-in is needed, and every tool only reads.
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest ski trips to Ischgl for two adults in February 2027.
Charter trips to Crete in July 2027 for two adults and two children, one week.
Which ski destinations have the most trips this winter?

positive.description: Find bookable trips for a place, month and party, cheapest first
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest ski trips to Ischgl for two adults in February 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_trips with ski, Ischgl, February 2027, 2 adults, sorted cheapest. Lists hotels in Ischgl with dates, the price for two in DKK, the selling travel agency and a booking link.

positive.description: A family party and a trip length
positive.prompt: We are two adults and two children. Which charter trips to Crete start in July 2027 and last 7 or 8 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_trips with charter, Crete, July 2027, 2 adults and 2 children, 7 or 8 days. Lists family trips to Crete priced for that party, with booking links.

positive.prompt: Golf trips to Spain in March 2027 for two adults, under 8,000 kr per person.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_trips with golf, Spain, March 2027, 2 adults, at most 8,000 DKK per person. Lists golf trips in Spain within the budget, with booking links.

positive.description: Explore what is available for one kind of trip
positive.prompt: Which ski destinations have the most trips this winter?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_init for ski. Names the ski destinations with the most trips and how many trips start in each month.

positive.description: Filters that find_trips does not have: hotel stars and meal plan
positive.prompt: 4-star all-inclusive charter hotels in Turkey for August 2027 for two adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with charter, Turkey, at least 4 stars, all inclusive, August 2027, 2 adults. Lists only 4-star or better all-inclusive hotels in Turkey, with prices and booking links.

negative.description: Weather is not a trip search: ChatGPT answers without calling Kompare.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Ischgl next week?

negative.description: An existing booking is the travel agency's to handle: ChatGPT answers without calling Kompare.
negative.prompt: How do I get a refund for a trip I already booked with a travel agency?

negative.description: Creative writing, not travel: ChatGPT answers without calling Kompare.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about skiing.

publication.release_notes: First version: search package holidays and niche trips from Danish travel agencies, with live prices and booking links.
